notes.title: 7 New Languages + Major Discount Coming Soon! ✨
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to share that Sands of Hope will be receiving a brand-new update on Sept. 29th. [/p][p]With this patch we're adding [b]7 new languages[/b] to the game to make the adventure more accessible to players all around the world. Languages are:[/p][list][*][p]Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese (Brazilian)[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Our goal always been to create an experience that everyone can enjoy, and this update is a big step toward that. Thank you for supporting us and helping the game grow, it means a lot![/p][p][/p][p]And there's more good news: Sands of Hope will aslo be part of the Steam Autumn Sale later this month! If you've been waiting for the right time to grab it at an irresistible price, or want it to share it with a friend, this will be the [b]perfect chance :) (-46% discount!!!)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The game has been out for a little bit more than a month now, and what makes us keep working on it is the love and support received from all of you so, again, THANK YOU <3[/p]

notes.title: Sands of Hope is OUT NOW!✨
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, the day is finally here![/p][p]We're incredibly excited (and a bit emotional) to announce that [b]Sands of Hope is now available on Steam![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Get it today with a special 20% discount![/b][/h3][previewyoutube="4WW68TBu_a0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Whether you're here for a cozy evening journey or just to support a small indie dev, we’re beyond grateful to have you. Every wishlist, play session, and review means the world to us, THANK YOU <3[/p][p][/p][p]A peaceful adventure through a handcrafted open world awaits![/p][p][/p][h3]Pere & Frankie[/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Sands Of Hope releases on August 4th!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="l-ifA2EVmME;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey folks![/p][p]We're thrilled to officially announce that [b]Sands Of Hope will be releasing on August 4th![/b][/p][p][/p][p]It's been such a joy crafting this adventure, and we can't wait for you to experience the full journey through Cydonia![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for all your support- [b]for playing the demo,[/b] leaving comments on social media and following the game and wishlisting it on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]We're just 2 devs working on it and we're so happy to be reaching the finish line. Thanks again![/p][p][/p][p]We'll be posting here again when the full game comes out ;)[/p]

notes.title: Public demo available NOW!
notes.notes: [h2]Sands Of Hope is having a FREE playable Demo![/h2][p][/p][p]We're happy to announce that a public demo is available for you to [b]play now[/b], and that it will take part in the Steam's Next Fest![/p][p][/p][p]This is your chance to take a first step into Hope's adventure. If you enjoy your time with the demo, we'd be so grateful if you [b]leave a review :)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Also, if you want to leave some feedback, please let us know your comments and suggestions [b]via e-mail with the subject "feedback"[/b], we'll appreciate it![/p][p][/p][p][i]contact@guatekestudios.com[/i][/p][p][/p]
